thread:
emma (customer): Hey team — our monthly bill is way higher than our SDK token estimates. SDK shows ~1.2k tokens for a run but dashboard and invoice show ~3.1k. Invoice ID INV-2026-03-09-44321. Can someone explain?

tara (support): Sorry about the surprise, @emma. Can you paste the SDK snippet and a sample request/response (sanitized)? Also which SDK version?

emma (customer): Using the JS SDK v0.11.4. Here's minimal repro:```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RD_KEY });
const res = await client.chat.completions.create({
  model: 'rw-lite',
  messages: [
    { role: 'system', content: 'You are an assistant.' },
    { role: 'user', content: 'Summarize this paragraph...' }
  ],
  max_tokens: 300
});
console.log(res.estimatedTokens); // ~1200
```
Billing dashboard shows total_tokens=3123 for the same call (we sampled request/ts).

alex (eng-ml): Thanks, @emma. Two quick things that commonly cause this mismatch: hidden system/tool messages and tokenization differences between the estimator and server. Can you share a sample server-side log for that request (request_id)?

emma (customer): Request id is r-0a9f3b2c. Server log line: `token_breakdown: prompt:2100 completion:1023 total:3123`. Client estimate prints only `estimatedTokens: 1200`.

maria (devex): Noted. The older JS SDK estimator uses a fast heuristic that intentionally undercounts some assistant/tool inserts (to keep estimates cheap), and it also doesn't include model-inserted system prompts used for safety/tool routing. SDK v0.12+ added a debug mode that requests an exact server token breakdown.

john (billing): For invoices we always use server-side metering (the runtime metering at the gateway). That includes all tokens consumed by hidden system prompts, tool pulls, and streamed tool responses. So dashboard=invoice.

alex (eng-ml): To be explicit: possible causes in this thread order of impact:
- hidden model/system prompts injected at the gateway (not in user messages)
- tools calling (e.g., function/tool responses inserted into model input)
- SDK heuristic rounding/omissions and different tokenizers (BPE edge cases)
- retries or fallback model calls increasing totals

tara (support): @emma can you try with SDK v0.12.3 and attach output with `RD_DEBUG=token_breakdown` env? That will produce: `x-rd-token-breakdown: prompt=2100 completion=1023 tools=0 system_injected=200` in the debug header.

emma (customer): Ok will try. Quick question — do we get credited for double-counted retries? We saw one retry on 03/09 for 502 and it seems counted twice.

john (billing): Retries are charged; we log each request that reaches the runtime. If a retry reached the gateway and consumed tokens, it is billable. We can check the trace for r-0a9f3b2c and see timestamps. If the retry was internal and not charged, we can issue an adjustment but need logs.

emma (customer): Ran SDK v0.12.3 with debug. Header shows: `x-rd-token-breakdown: prompt=2100 completion=1023 tools=0 system_injected=200`. The SDK previously only printed `estimatedTokens: 1200` (it was excluding the system_injected 200 and using a rough user-only estimate).

maria (devex): That matches expectations. Two actionables: (1) we'll update SDK docs to highlight that SDK estimates are heuristics and to show how to enable debug-mode for exact breakdowns; (2) we'll ship a small patch to make the estimator warn when a big gap (>20%) exists between heuristic and server breakdown.

alex (eng-ml): Engineering note: there is also an open PR to include tool outputs in the client estimator for v0.13.0; that should narrow gaps for function-heavy workloads.

tara (support): For @emma specifically — since we have the request id and the invoice, I'll open a billing review to double-check retry charges vs normal call. @john can you confirm you have what you need?

john (billing): Yep I have the request id and invoice. I'll audit the traces and follow up here within 24 hours.

deploy-bot: Deployed sdk@v0.12.3 to staging (build 5721) :rocket:

emma (customer): Thanks everyone — helpful. Please flag any adjustments here. One docs suggestion: make the limited accuracy of "estimatedTokens" more prominent.

maria (devex): Good point, @emma — we'll add a top-banner note and an example showing how to enable the exact breakdown header. Will post PR link when ready.

tara (support): Closing loop when billing confirms. If anyone else sees large gaps, escalate to eng-ml with request_id and timestamp. :thumbsup:
